picks.title: Introducing ULPG: an open landing-page guide for people and AI agents
picks.excerpt: Most landing-page advice comes as a template: a hero of a certain height, three feature cards, a...
picks.rationale: A newly released open guide that both designers and coding agents can read, so teams can hand landing-page rules to an agent tomorrow. It is different from the 10-20 WunderUI design-system launch.

picks.title: How Vercel Agent accesses production safely
picks.excerpt: Learn how Vercel Agent investigates production issues, requests approval for changes, and uses scoped credentials to limit access while carrying out a plan.
picks.rationale: A first-party breakdown of how an agent investigates production issues, asks for approval before acting and limits itself with scoped credentials. It is a concrete pattern for designing approval and permission steps in agent products. It is a separate post from the broad 10-17 Ship recap, and it backfills the stale Affinity MCP pick.

picks.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
picks.excerpt: New tools joining NVIDIA Cosmos are helping accelerate data pipelines, train, evaluate and optimize world models more efficiently, and improve accuracy at lower cost.
picks.rationale: A concrete new release of world-model tooling from a credible vendor, and it fills the render/3D slot. It is a different release from the 10-22 NVIDIA Europe industrial post and the 10-12 Odyssey-3 world model.

picks.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
picks.rationale: A new release: Block's Dessa voice model is built to sound hesitant and human, not polished. It is a concrete reference point for teams designing the personality and pacing of a voice interface. No history match, and no other section has claimed it.

picks.title: Siemens expands agentic AI for 3D IC design workflows
picks.excerpt: The workflow coordinates electrothermal analysis across seven EDA tools to evaluate hundreds of design points per cycle.
picks.rationale: A new announcement from a major engineering-software vendor: an agentic workflow that coordinates seven EDA tools to sweep hundreds of design points per cycle. It fills the CAD slot as a backfill. Its history_match (Adobe/NVIDIA agentic creation, 10-18) is a different vendor and domain.
